title: The pullback of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then the pullback $f^*\mathcal G$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BG (label lemma-pullback-quasi-coherent) with its proof (local global presentation by direct sums of O_Y, f^* right exact and commuting with direct sums, f^*O_Y = O_X); for schemes, quasi-coherent in the sense of Modules 01BD agrees with the affine-local definition of [pqf-def-coherent] by Schemes, Lemma 01IA (lemma-quasi-coherent-affine) and Section 01LA (section-quasi-coherent)
